description.en: The ID of the Cloud Backup client.
The ID of the resource group.
The ID of the backup vault.

descriptions.zh: 调用该接口会将备份客户端升级到最新版本，一旦升级成功，无法回退备份客户端的版本。
descriptions.en: Upgrades a Cloud Backup client to the latest version. After the upgrade succeeds, the client version cannot be rolled back.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr upgrade-client --vault-id v-000djw8ci0000003ic --client-id c-000boklw00000063a9 --resource-group-id rg-acfmy6uja5wyc2i --region cn-hangzhou
